title: Migration entry test coverage
text: One shared table-driven harness discovers executable migration scripts, checks destructive serving floors, applies twice on empty booted and seeded current schemas, and re-proves standing invariants. Dedicated tests retain reachable data-change and refusal assertions and retire with their scripts. The control plane declares one code baseline through ordinal 0106; its 102 predecessor scripts and migration-only helpers are removed after every known hosted ledger is verified. Births record only the baseline. Existing ledgers collapse atomically only when their exact predecessor names and content digests match the temporary frozen manifest; repeat boot is a no-op and failures restore membership and guard state. The carrying release becomes the baseline serving floor. Rollback below that release is unsupported after collapse. All readers consume baseline metadata without importing a migration script. A following release removes the temporary predecessor manifest and collapse step after all eight hosted ledgers prove baseline membership. Portable imports require current schema and preserve immutable snapshots rather than reconstructing retired tables, column names or old QA data. A reverse import guard keeps runtime behavior and retired protocol names with domain owners.
